name: Crystal Creek Falls - DCK Hut circuit rainforest walk
description:
Saturday, 24th Feb, 2024
Crystal Creek Falls - DCK Hut circuit rainforest walk 
 
Leader- Wilfred Karnoll 

Rated – Medium : Full day walk - majority is rainforest track walking, small amount of off-track. Some moderate hills.

Length – approx 15 km.

Location – Paluma Dam / Mt Spec environs, based on upper Crystal Creek.

Features – Crystal Creek Falls, one of the best swimming pools anywhereJohnstone’s Clearing, DCK Hut and upper Crystal Creek, and rainforest track walking.

Walking Terrain – rough bush tracks, uneven footings, loose rocks, tree roots, creek crossings (slippery rocks), small amount of bush bashing (500 mr), some moderate hills to climb. Potential for leeches.

Walk starts from Paluma Dam and is a circuit walk via Crystal Creek Falls, Johnstone’s Clearing, and DCK Hut.

Meet Time and location – 0630 for car pooling location TBA. Aim for walk start no later than 0815. Details will be emailed to registered (RSVP) and approved participants.

Aim to be back at cars at the dam car park by 5 pm. 

If carpooling, please bring a change of clothes and spare towel for the travel in someone else’s car.
Also, a small contribution to the driver for fuel / running cost is appreciated – club recommends $5 per pax to help with fuel.

RSVP [Button below[
Fee: non-members/visitors/-  $5 . TBWC Club members - Free.
Everyone welcome on this walk - You can become a TBWC member after 3 walks as a visitor


 
IMPORTANT - If you have not walked with the club before - please get in touch with the walk leader to discuss suitability, before you RSVP
For details please contact the walk leader -  Wilfred Karnoll - wilfred.suzanne@bigpond.com
 


RSVP: https://forms.gle/xD6tTDnwsieAanWZA

name: Tea at the Top Of Jourama & exploring Waterview Ck Falls
description:
📷- https://wanderstories.space

Walk Leader: Cherry Judge 

Location: Paluma Range NP

Difficulty: Grade 3 and may be 4 for some. , off-track, Off Track and very steep but short 
. 
Duration: Allow for 3-4 hrs return ]

Walk Leader: Cherry Judge


🌳About🌳

This short and sweet adventure sees us head to the top of Jourama Falls .
The track is very steep and rough and stays like that for about an hour till we get to the top of the falls. The plan is to park ourselves for a swim at the top here and set up for a cuppa…. But not have it YET…… :) 
What we will do for those keen to explore is creek hop along Waterview creek till we come to a short but lovely set of waterfalls - just a short walk. 
Be prepared to get your feet wet as likely we will be walking along the creek. 


When we rest - it is tea time and a swim. 
Then heading back the same way. 


🌳What to bring:🌳
-Sunscreen and hat
-Insect repellent
Salt for Leeches.
Appropriate footwear- the rocks during some of the creeks are very slippery at this time of the year
A walking stick might be useful in gauging water depth.
-Snacks and morning tea
-Water 
Personal First Aid kit and Snake Bandage x 2

RSVP:
If you have never walked with the TBWC before, please reach out to the walk leader to ascertain the suitability of this walk for you before you RSVP - Cherry Judge - 0430073341  or email - charismajudge@veteducation.com.au

Visitors are welcome - it is $5 to cover our club insurance. 
You can do 3 walks and qualify to become a TBWC member!
